in_marathi.name: Varuni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Varuni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Varuni is the Hindu goddess of rain and fertility. She is believed to be the mother of the rivers and the giver of the monsoon rains. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted holding a jug of water or a lotus. Varuni is also considered to be the goddess of intoxication and is often associated with the god Indra.
